name: Boot & Platform
description: Boot entry point, assembly loader, and linker script that define the initial CPU state and memory layout

name: Kernel Core
description: Main kernel entry point, initialization, system console output, and common type definitions used throughout the kernel

name: Hardware Abstraction
description: CPU segmentation (GDT), I/O port abstraction, interrupt descriptor table (IDT) and PIC management, PCI bus enumeration

name: Memory Management
description: Free-list-based kernel heap allocator with global operator new/delete overrides

name: Task Management
description: Cooperative multitasking with round-robin scheduler and interrupt-based syscall dispatch

name: Device Drivers
description: Hardware driver framework and concrete drivers for PS/2 keyboard, PS/2 mouse, VGA graphics, ATA storage, and AMD Am79C973 Ethernet NIC

name: Filesystem
description: FAT12/16/32 filesystem with MBR partition parsing, cluster-chain management, file operations, and SD card wrapper (adapted from Arduino SdFat library)

name: GUI
description: Graphical desktop environment with composable widgets, draggable windows, mouse cursor rendering, and hierarchical event dispatch

name: Networking
description: Full network protocol stack: Ethernet framing, ARP resolution, IPv4 routing, ICMP ping, UDP datagrams, and TCP connection state machine

name: Build & Config
description: Build system configuration and project settings
